mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_record(tenant_id,order_id,status,provider) VALUES(#{tenant},#{order},'READY','UNASSIGNED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id=order_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fulfillment_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
SELECT FROM fulfillment_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM fulfillment_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id>#{after} ORDER BY order_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_record SET status='SHIPPED',tracking_no=#{tracking},provider=#{provider},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status='READY' AND blocked=FALSE AND version=#{version}
UPDATE fulfillment_record SET status='DELIVERED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status='SHIPPED' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE fulfillment_record SET blocked=#{blocked},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND version=#{version}
